note: Two campgrounds on former sand-pit lakes near La Grange. At Boulder Lake Campground the north row of electric sites opens onto lawn at the lake's edge, while the basic sites sit inside the loop. Wakonda Lake Campground, 1.5 km south, rings a grassy peninsula with 15 full-hookup sites, most of them open to the water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $14-15 basic base, electric +14 / full hookup +20 (2027), 50A + water + sewer, year-round; added military $2, 96 sites (81 Boulder Lake + 15 Wakonda Lake, not 13) to 173 ft with pull-throughs, showers/flush/vault/dump/laundry/water. Lakefront confirmed at both campgrounds (imagery + site photos). SPLIT recommended (1.45 km, own peninsula road). Booking (manual) not touched; additions flagged.
